Profile the log-likelihood over the extreme-value threshold

Source: R/em_profile_c.R
em_profile_c.Rd

Evaluates the full-data log-likelihood at each candidate value of the extreme-value threshold \(C_{EV}\), holding all other parameters fixed, and returns the profile together with its maximiser. This is the ECME update of \(C_{EV}\) in Appendix A1 of Randahl and Vegelius (2024); it is run once per EM iteration, in both the warm-up and the convergence phase.

Usage

em_profile_c(y, x_obj, par, c_candidates)

Arguments

y

Numeric response vector.

x_obj

List of component design matrices (see em_extend_design).

par

List of current parameter values with elements Beta.multinom.ZC, Beta.multinom.PL, Beta.NB, Alpha.NB, Beta.PL.

c_candidates

Numeric vector of candidate \(C_{EV}\) values, from em_c_candidates.

Value

A list with

profile

a data frame with columns c and loglik;

c_hat

the candidate(s) attaining the maximum log-likelihood;

loglik_max

that maximum.

See also

evzinb(), evinb()
